snippet.title: UNDER THE ISLAND ► Launch Trailer (PC, Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, Xbox)
snippet.description:
UNDER THE ISLAND has been released into the wild... and is OUT NOW for PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4, and Xbox! Thank you for all the support and we're also thrilled that the game has debuted on Metacritic at a score of 85!

Step into the shoes of Nia, and embark on an epic 2D action-adventure RPG steeped in '90s charm! Battle fierce monsters, solve clever puzzles, and explore a world alive with mystery as you race to save your new home before it’s too late.
